title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Share Rare Family Photos on Daughter Dua's Birthday
excerpt: The couple released a series of intimate black-and-white photographs with their daughter on her second birthday, giving fans a rare glimpse of their growing family as they prepare for their second child.
body:
• Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh shared intimate black-and-white photographs with daughter Dua on her second birthday, September 8.
  • The photos offer a rare look at the family together, with Deepika showcasing her baby bump ahead of their second child's arrival.
  • The couple announced their second pregnancy in April 2026, and Deepika is currently in her third trimester.

Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh marked their daughter Dua's second birthday on September 8 by sharing a series of intimate black-and-white photographs — a rare move for the couple, who have kept their daughter largely away from the public eye since her birth in 2024.

The images, posted on the couple's Instagram handles, show the family of three in tender, candid moments. In one photograph, Ranveer gently holds Deepika's baby bump as the pair smile with their foreheads touching. Deepika wears a fitted lace ensemble while Ranveer opts for a simple white shirt and trousers.

Another photograph features two-year-old Dua standing between her parents, playfully hiding her face as Deepika and Ranveer crouch beside her. True to their decision to shield Dua from the spotlight, the child's face remains unseen in all the photographs.

Sharing the album, the couple wrote: "Baby Dua and our hearts are getting bigger! Thank you for your blessings!"

Second Pregnancy Announcement

Deepika and Ranveer announced they were expecting their second child in April 2026 through a joint Instagram post that featured Dua holding a pregnancy test showing two pink lines, with both parents gently holding her hands. The image was accompanied by evil eye emojis. Deepika is currently in her third trimester.

From Ram-Leela to Parenthood

The couple first met on the sets of Sanjay Leela Bhansali's 2013 romantic drama Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela and went on to star together in Bajirao Mastani and Padmaavat before tying the knot at Lake Como in Italy on November 14, 2018. They welcomed Dua — a name meaning "prayer" — on September 8, 2024.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=7Ih-tubYbWs

In December 2024, the couple hosted a meet-and-greet with Mumbai paparazzi to introduce their daughter, though no cameras or phones were allowed at the event. The family photographs released on Dua's birthday represent one of the most open glimpses the couple have offered since.

Fans Spot a Resemblance

Social media was flooded with reactions after the photographs were posted, with fans and industry colleagues commenting on the family's warmth. Many were quick to draw comparisons between Dua's animated expressions and Ranveer's signature high-energy persona, dubbing the toddler a "mini Ranveer."

What's Next for the Couple

Despite preparing to welcome her second child, Deepika has continued with her work commitments. She will next appear in Siddharth Anand's King, starring alongside Shah Rukh Khan and Suhana Khan. Ranveer, meanwhile, has begun shooting for Pralay following the success of Dhurandhar.
image_caption: Bollywood actress Deepika Padukone. She and husband Ranveer Singh shared rare family photos on their daughter Dua's first birthday.
